notes.title: UPDATE #12 - REANIMATION POTIONS
notes.notes:
This small update includes a new type of potion: Reanimation Potion. This potion allows you to use again a Minimonsters that fought in the previous battle.

I also include some small improvements

[h3]Changelog v.151[/h3]

- A new type of potion has been added: Reanimation Potion.
- The final text of the minimonsters' farewell screen has been changed and its graphics have been changed a little bit.
- Minimonsters capture screen has been slightly changed.
- Now the game includes the basic Windows fonts used in the game in case the player does not have them.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/41106132/92c80726e1b22c555f068139f5bed9ecdbf4faf1.png[/img]

- Thank you for reading -

notes.title: UPDATE #10 - SPIKED MINIMONSTERS
notes.notes:
This new update includes a new game mechanic: Minimonsters with a new skill 'Spiked'.

Also included are 4 new minimonsters and 4 new top-level quests.

Here is the full changelog v1.4:

ADDED
- Added 4 new minimonsters with the 'Spiked' skill. (3 bronze and 1 gold)
- Added 4 new adventures (Level 3).
- Added skill icons for minimonsters in the battlefield selection panel.

CHANGES
- Changed the word 'Rainbow' in the element of some minimonsters to 'Rainb' to avoid the minimonster'ss characteristics boxes getting out of sync.
- Spiked Crab now has the special skill 'Spiked'. 
- The explanatory message of the 'poison' skill has been modified and improved.
- The description of the skill 'Stoicism' is now better explained.
- The description of the skill 'Stun' is now better explained.

BUGSFIXES
- Fixed the size of an image of the MiniMonster 'Angry Turtle'.

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/41106132/fa23a5b37a0b896fa7498f55c2c47fb54f621c78.png[/img]

THANK YOU FOR PLAYING!

notes.title: UPDATE #5 - FASTER COMBATS!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41106132/cbffbc30436080fc36d41d898400ad9b68a5cc02.png[/img]

Some players felt that being able to nullify attacks, and having 0 damage was no fun at all and could even make combat tedious. And I think they were quite right.

From now on all attacks made, and even defenses, will cause a minimum damage of 1. Also the poison damage has been increased to 2.

This update is important because it can change a lot the combat strategy. 

I hope you like it.

Changelog v1.2:
- Minimum damage caused by each attack or defense will always be 1.
- Poison increases the damage caused from 1 to 2. 

THANK YOU FOR PLAYING WOM.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41106132/3c97491b44810aad60e558361f72e7400ce65233.png[/img]

notes.title: #3 - BIG, BIG UPDATE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41106132/e0699aa775c239c51696e2f63a9f250d33016642.png[/img]

After receiving very good feedback, I decided a few weeks ago to make a big update. And here it is. This practically changes the way you play WOM.

I would like to give special thanks to Birbarian (developer of AvianSong) and Almarod. Your ideas were very helpful. Thank you.

CHANGELOG - VERSION 1.1 -

ADDED
- 11 new MiniMonsters (60 total).
- 9 new MiniBosses.
- 8 new Adventures (35 total).
- The MiniMonster chosen for the fight will no longer be available for the next one, so the player must choose another one.
- New generation system for MiniMonsters. Now, gold or silver MiniMonsters are harder to find.
- New options to change Minimonster or Exit in Choosing Battleground screen.
- New Information button in battlegrounds screen.

IMPROVEMENTS
- Balanced game difficulty.
- A lot of graphic of MiniMonsters have been upgraded.
- Captured Minimonsters now have an higher level depending on the number of lands cleared.
- Now, all the gold combats in a land will be against mini-bosses.
- Battlegrounds will not be the same when they are generated.

CHANGES
-The minimum number of MiniMonsters in your party is 2 now.

BUGFIXES
- Fixed the size of a lot of MiniMonsters.
- Fixed an issue where you clicked on a MiniMonster in combat and the combat was finished.
- Fixed an issue where you could choose an empty space as MiniMonster for the combat.
- Fixed a visual bug when you change your enemy and appeared a silver or gold star Minimon.
- Some typos fixed.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41106132/3c97491b44810aad60e558361f72e7400ce65233.png[/img]

notes.title: UPDATE #1 - EVOLVE
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41106132/e08e2ff60273894c33f25029d741dfddf7ed9de9.png[/img]

I am preparing a big update that will change the way you play WOM. While it arrives here I bring you a small one that includes a new MiniMonster.

-FEATURES-

NEW SPECIAL SKILL: EVOLVE
Those MiniMonsters with the ability to evolve have some chance to evolve whenever they win a combat. 

- Octimin has Evolve skill now.
- Shroom has Evolve skill now.
- Blue Mage has Evolve skill now.

NEW MINIMONSTER:
- Added new MiniMonster: Angry Turtle (with Evolve Skill)

GRAPHICS:
- Changed all graphics of special skills.
- Improved Octomin MiniMonster image.
- Improved Creeper MiniMonster image.
- Improved Yanfly MiniMonster image.

CHANGES & FIXES:
- Changed attributes of Minimonster WTurtle. Now has the special ability: Stoicism.
- Fixed a message when the player clicked on the special ability: Poison.
- Fixed an issue that did not show the final boss image: Litch.

Thank you very much.
